The edge examples hold together well. The long title, note, tags, and address wrap without breaking the card, and the unusually long tag and address stay within the layout. The bare bookmark is fine as a clean minimum; I don’t need repeated prompts to add notes or tags. The invalid-link response and letter-badge fallback also feel appropriate.

I do need permanent deletion as a separate action from Archive. Archive should remain reversible, while Delete should clearly warn me that the bookmark will be removed for good and ask for confirmation.

A small saved date would be useful, especially in a large collection. Keep it quiet, but show when the bookmark was added; retaining when it was last updated would also help when editing older items.
